commit.message:
docs: correct and expand README Key Capabilities accuracy

docs: correct and expand README Key Capabilities accuracy

- Removed a false "four concrete shape kinds this library implements" claim
  in the shape-insertion bullet — the file's own API Reference table already
  lists GroupShape as a fifth real, instantiable shape class, directly
  contradicting the claim.
- Added two real, previously undocumented capabilities to the same bullet:
  ShapeCollection::reorder() (shape z-order control) and traversal of nested
  shapes inside a loaded GroupShape via its own shapes() collection.
- Corrected the text-formatting capability description, which was scoped to
  "run level" only. Real ParagraphFormat (alignment, spacing, indentation,
  margins) and TextFrameFormat (margins, wrap, anchoring, columns, autofit)
  both exist and are reachable via Paragraph::paragraph_format() and
  TextFrame::text_frame_format() — the bullet now covers all three real
  formatting levels the library actually supports.

Verification: every class/method named above was independently confirmed
against the real, current source at this commit (include/Aspose/Slides/Foss/
shape_collection.h, group_shape.h, paragraph_format.h, text_frame_format.h,
paragraph.h, text_frame.h) before being added or changed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
